# Jake's Car Care

> Mobile car valeting based in Strokestown, Co. Roscommon, Ireland. Jake
> drives to your home or workplace anywhere within a 45 km drive of
> Strokestown. Weekends only, Saturday and Sunday 9:00-18:00.
> Phone/text: 087 766 5058 (+353 87 766 5058).

## Services & prices (EUR)

- Full Valet: €100-€120, ~4 hours — exterior shampoo & wax, wheels, glass, full interior deep clean, leather/fabric treatment
- Interior Only: €70-€90, ~3 hours — full vacuum, dashboard & trim, leather/fabric treatment, rubbish removed
- Exterior Only: €50, ~2 hours — hand shampoo, wax, wheels & tyre shine, exterior glass
- Add-ons: Protector Wax +€25, Iron Fallout & Tar Remover +€20

Customers provide an outdoor tap and a socket; Jake brings all equipment.
Payment on the day: cash or Revolut. Free cancellation with reasonable notice.

## Coverage & call-out fees

- Free call-out within 12 km or ~15 minutes' drive of Strokestown
- Beyond that: €1 per km after the first 12 km, rounded up to the nearest €5
- Online booking limit: 45 km driving distance
- Real driving distances from Strokestown: Roscommon Town 19.7 km (€10),
  Longford Town 23.4 km (€15), Carrick-on-Shannon 25.8 km (€15),
  Castlerea 30.1 km (€20), Boyle 30.9 km (€20), Ballymahon 35.5 km (€25),
  Edgeworthstown 38.5 km (€30)
- By arrangement only (outside 45 km): Athlone, Loughrea
